project.title: Activated sludge microbial community dynamics and their links to nitrous oxide emissions at a full-scale wastewater treatment plant
project.description: The goal of this study was to link activated sludge microbial community dynamics and process conditions to seasonal nitrous oxide (N2O) variation at a full-scale wastewater treatment plant (WWTP). We analyzed microbial community dynamics in several parallel treatment lines over 14 months by 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing, supported by a small dataset of shotgun metagenomic sequencing. The community variations were correlated with extensive process monitoring data, including N2O. These kinds of WWTP-specific microbial community and process data could be used to support the selection of targeted N2O mitigation strategies.
